.husky/pre-commit.local.IMPLICIT: a commit staging the vault data runs its checker and is refused on any fault it prints: data/gallery.json, data/styles.json or anything under images/ runs `node validate.js --staged` (#1); data/gallery.json, data/styles.json or data/vault-data.js runs `node bundle.js --staged`, refused when the staged bundle does not match the staged JSON (#32); data/round-log.jsonl runs `node round-log.js --staged`, refused on a malformed row or a row that changes one HEAD holds beyond adding its final_pick, rejections or on_weakest (#95); data/corrections-log.jsonl runs `node corrections-log.js --staged`, refused on a malformed row or a row that changes one HEAD holds beyond answering its pending ruling (#166); data/calibration-log.jsonl runs `node calibration-log.js --staged`, refused on a malformed row, a run whose figures disagree with the disagreements listed under them, or any change to or removal of a row HEAD holds (#168). Each log checker also refuses where git cannot be read.
.husky/pre-commit.local.JUSTIFIED: fail-safe — a malformed library entry travels into every brief copied from it, and the commit is the last local moment to catch it (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3631 step 2); the page opened from its folder reads only the bundle, so a stale one shows the library a version behind with nothing saying so; the round log holds the founder's first picks, made before he read the critic, which cannot be recovered once rewritten; the corrections log holds his corrections in his own words, and a reworded entry or a ruling changed after he gave it cannot be told apart from his own later; round-log.js counts "calibration due" from the calibration log's last round_log_rows, and a run's agreement figures are the founder's only measure of the critic, which cannot be re-measured.
.husky/pre-commit.local.DEFEAT: none — fix the fault or row the checker names, append a new row, or run node bundle.js and commit data/vault-data.js with the JSON.
